verdict.rationale: monday.com's apps framework explicitly supports creating custom board views, item views, dashboard widgets, and full-page apps. Its open-source Vibe React component library is positioned so apps 'look native' from day one, and apps can add actions into the item, board, and column menus. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs beyond marketing-level statements (e.g., view/widget APIs, theming details), independent or hands-on corroboration that custom views and widgets actually feel native.

support.subject: As a designer, I can build custom views and dashboard widgets that feel native to the product

citations.quote: Create custom board views, item views, dashboard widgets, and full-page apps.
